description: This Java source file defines the Currency entity class used in the sales management system. It maps to the CURRENCY table in the database and includes fields such as id, currency code, name, and supported status. It provides getter and setter methods for these properties and extends a generic entity class for persistence.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Entity class representing a currency, with fields for code, name, supported status, and the Java Currency object itself, mapped to the CURRENCY table in the database.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the currency entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the currency entity.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the Java Currency object associated with this entity.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the Java Currency object and updates the currency code accordingly.

methods.name: getSupported
methods.description: Returns whether this currency is supported.

methods.name: setSupported
methods.description: Sets the supported status for the currency.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the currency code, ensuring it reflects the current Currency object.

methods.name: getSymbol
methods.description: Returns the symbol of the currency.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the currency.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the currency.
